id: 20_Purpose of safety data sheet MSDS laboratory microbiology safety chemical
title: 安全技术说明书有什么用
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/20_Purpose of safety data sheet MSDS laboratory microbiology safety chemical.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/20_Purpose of safety data sheet MSDS laboratory microbiology safety chemical/src.py

points.K1: 给操作的人，也给救援的人

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一份空白的说明书站在实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench, holding up a data sheet with blank sections, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 说明书到底有什么用？
overlay: 安全技术说明书有什么用

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现手、柜子、废液桶、急救箱图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to floating icons: a gloved hand, a storage cabinet, a waste container and a first aid kit.
shots.narration: 今天把它的用处一条条说清。

shots.scene: 阿杰要用一瓶新到的固定液，直接拧开瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a newly delivered bottle with a hazard pictogram on its label and starts to twist the cap open.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿到一瓶新试剂，拧开就要用。

shots.scene: 小研把空白说明书放到他面前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a data sheet with blank sections in front of him.
shots.narration: 小研问：说明书看了吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，说明书厚厚一叠
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking at the thick stack of pages.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：这么厚，看它干嘛？

shots.scene: 欣欣出现在两人中间，竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot appears between the two students and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 它能帮你，也能帮来救你的人。

shots.section_title: 给操作的人，也给救援的人
shots.scene: 左边是实验人员图标，右边是急救和消防人员图标，中间是说明书
shots.prompt_en: A data sheet in the middle, a lab worker icon on the left, and paramedic and firefighter icons on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书的主要目的，是给两类人用：
overlay: 给操作的人，也给救援的人

shots.section_title: 给操作的人，也给救援的人
shots.scene: 小研在实验台前翻看说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a data sheet at the lab bench before starting work.
shots.narration: 一是每天和它打交道的操作人员，

shots.section_title: 给操作的人，也给救援的人
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员和急救人员图标拿着同一份说明书
shots.prompt_en: The security officer holds a data sheet, with a paramedic icon beside him.
shots.narration: 二是出事时赶来的应急人员。

shots.section_title: 给操作的人，也给救援的人
shots.scene: 说明书分成三条路：使用、储存、处置
shots.prompt_en: A data sheet splits into three paths with icons: a gloved hand, a cabinet and a waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 他们要的信息，主要有三类。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴好护目镜和手套，在通风柜前操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears goggles and gloves and works at a chemical fume hood.
shots.narration: 第一，怎么安全地操作危险物质：

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、通风柜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: goggles, gloves and a chemical fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 戴什么防护，在哪儿操作，

shots.scene: 说明书上操作一节被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The handling section of a data sheet is highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 这些都能在说明书里找到。

shots.scene: 化学品柜里分区摆放的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Reagent bottles arranged in separate zones inside a chemical storage cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，怎么妥善储存：

shots.scene: 温度计、太阳打叉、密封盖图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a thermometer, a crossed-out sun, and a tightly closed cap. No people.
shots.narration: 存放温度、避光、密封，

shots.scene: 两个瓶子之间有一道隔板
shots.prompt_en: Two reagent bottles separated by a divider inside a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 以及不能和什么放在一起。

shots.scene: 用剩的试剂倒进贴好标签的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Leftover reagent is poured into a labeled chemical waste container with a funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，怎么正确处置：

shots.scene: 说明书上处置一节被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The disposal section of a data sheet is highlighted next to a waste container icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用剩的危险物质怎么处理，照着做。

shots.scene: 说明书上亮起健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: A health hazard pictogram lights up on the data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书还告诉你四类危害。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上标出眼、皮肤、肺几个部位
shots.prompt_en: A human outline with the eyes, skin and lungs highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 先是健康风险：伤眼、伤皮肤、伤肺，

shots.scene: 人体轮廓旁出现一个时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A human outline with a clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有的一次接触就伤人，有的慢慢累积。

shots.scene: 说明书上亮起火焰象形图
shots.prompt_en: A flame pictogram lights up on the data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 再是火灾危险：易不易燃，

shots.scene: 试剂瓶远离酒精灯和电热板
shots.prompt_en: A flammable liquid bottle placed far away from an alcohol lamp and a hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 要远离哪些火源和热源，

shots.scene: 灭火器和沙箱图标，带问号
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher icon and a sand bucket icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 万一着火，该用什么来灭。

shots.scene: 两个试剂瓶靠近时冒出警示闪光
shots.prompt_en: Two reagent bottles moving close together, with a warning flash between them. No people.
shots.narration: 第三是反应性：

shots.scene: 加热、遇水、遇空气三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a flame under a flask, a water drop and an air swirl. No people.
shots.narration: 遇热、遇水、遇空气会不会出事，

shots.scene: 小研把两瓶试剂分开放到不同的柜子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places two reagent bottles into two different cabinets.
shots.narration: 和哪些东西混在一起会剧烈反应。

shots.scene: 说明书上亮起环境象形图
shots.prompt_en: An environmental hazard pictogram lights up on the data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 最后是环境影响：

shots.scene: 河流和鱼的图标，水面上有一滴液体
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a river and a fish, with a drop of liquid falling toward the water. No people.
shots.narration: 对水里的生物、对土壤有没有危害。

shots.scene: 绿叶和河流图标，旁边说明书
shots.prompt_en: A green leaf and a river icon beside a data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 环境影响，说明书里也写着。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在说明书前，周围是三个用途图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a data sheet surrounded by three icons: a gloved hand, a cabinet and a waste container.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.scene: 操作人员和应急人员图标握手
shots.prompt_en: A lab worker icon and a paramedic icon shake hands over a data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书给操作的人，也给救援的人。

shots.scene: 四个危害象形图排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four hazard pictograms in a row: health hazard, flame, reaction flash and environment. No people.
shots.narration: 讲用、存、处置，讲四类危害。

shots.scene: 阿杰合上说明书，戴好防护开始操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the data sheet, puts on goggles and gloves, and starts working at the fume hood.
shots.narration: 用之前，先看说明书。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 先读说明书，再动手，下次见！
